rollups.text: Audrey’s dogs: Pepper, Precious, and Panda (named by 2023-03-27); puppy Pixie joined the household by 2023-04-02. By 2023-07-03, Audrey said all four were three years old. Audrey later identified Pepper and Panda as Labrador mixes and Precious and Pixie as Chihuahua mixes (2023-10-28); an earlier account described two as Jack Russell mixes and two as Chihuahua mixes (2023-07-03 and 2023-09-24), without naming the dogs in each group. Pixie took a few days to adjust and became especially close to Pepper (2023-04-02).

Audrey’s recurring dog activities and care: walks in parks and multiple daily walks (2023-04-08, 2023-06-13, 2023-09-24); hikes and national-park outings (2023-04-24..2023-04-30, 2023-05-05, 2023-05-22..2023-05-28, 2023-08-04); fetch and frisbee (2023-05-03, 2023-07-03); dog playdates, including with neighbors’ dogs (2023-05-03, 2023-06-30, 2023-09-06); agility practice at a dog park twice weekly (2023-08-04); a beach trip where all four swam and played (2023-09-30..2023-10-01); and a dog owners group with weekly meetups (by 2023-11-04). She also described using toys, puzzles, training, and hide-and-seek for enrichment (2023-11-04).

Audrey’s dog training and behavior care: she signed up for a positive-reinforcement bonding workshop scheduled for June 2023 and expected her dogs to learn quickly (2023-05-11); by 2023-07-03 she was taking a challenging training course and saw improvement, about seven weeks after signing up. She began agility classes by 2023-08-04 and practiced twice weekly, describing the work as sometimes tough but rewarding. She also worked on obedience and tricks (2023-09-24). After taking all four dogs to an animal behaviorist on 2023-10-25 because they were acting unusually, she used the recommended positive reinforcement and routine changes; by 2023-10-28 she saw progress, but the issues were not yet resolved.

Audrey’s dog grooming: she took a grooming course and learned techniques in August 2023; she advised going slowly and gently, attending to sensitive areas, and remaining patient and positive. She described daily brushing, regular baths, and nail trims as part of routine care (2023-08-24). On 2023-11-17, she took Pepper, Panda, Precious, and Pixie to a pet salon; they were excited but behaved well and were freshly groomed by 2023-11-22, roughly three months after her course.

Audrey’s outings with Andrew: Andrew recommended Fox Hollow, and Audrey said she would try it (2023-03-27); by 2023-04-02 she had not gone, as caring for Pixie kept her busy. Audrey later reported hiking at other places, including a national park (2023-05-22..2023-05-28) and a two-hour hike (by 2023-08-04). Audrey and Andrew discussed hiking together, with plans shifting from an unspecified August outing to a dog-friendly lakeside trail on 2023-11-04. On 2023-11-04, Audrey described the previous weekend with her four dogs as fun, but the record does not confirm that the planned hike with Andrew took place.

Audrey’s nature interests and outings: she explored parks and trails with her dogs, hiked to a sunset viewpoint in 2022, saw a hummingbird while hiking (2023-04-24..2023-04-30), and visited a national park and a mountain peak at sunset (2023-05-05 and 2023-05-22..2023-05-28). She visited a mountain lake with friends a few years before 2023-06-26 and said she had never been fishing (2023-08-24). In October 2023 she wanted to try birdwatching with a guidebook and binoculars and planned to check her schedule; she also wanted to try biking and asked Andrew about nearby routes. These were intentions, not confirmed outings.

Audrey’s jewelry-making and animal-shelter support: she began making jewelry from recycled materials as a hobby and later started selling it; she donated part of her profits to an animal shelter (reported 2023-10-06). She said she could no longer volunteer there by that date, but continued supporting its work through donations and looked for other ways to help. Earlier, she had said she hoped to volunteer at a shelter someday (2023-07-27).

Audrey’s cooking and baking: she baked blueberry treats (2023-04-08), said chicken pot pie was her favorite recipe and shared a family pie recipe (2023-07-03), and described cooking as creative, relaxing self-care. Garlic was her go-to ingredient; roasted chicken with garlic, lemon, and herbs was a favorite comfort meal (2023-07-03). She also made cookies for neighbors (2023-10-13). Audrey and Andrew proposed an unscheduled pastry party (2023-04-08).

Audrey’s garden and plants: she had a small garden and vegetable patch and said tending plants brought her peace (2023-09-24). She identified her flowers as Peruvian lilies and said she watered them and ensured they received enough sun. A shared photo was described as showing a cactus with white flowers, but the conversation did not establish that the cactus was one of her plants.

Audrey had four dogs by 2023-05-11 and named them as Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie by 2023-07-03. She took all four to the vet for checkups once in the record (2023-08-16), to an animal behaviorist once (2023-10-25), and to a pet salon once (2023-11-17). She said four were enough for now, while she might want more dogs someday (2023-08-16).

Audrey’s knee injury temporarily prevented her from walking her dogs; after she resumed walking, she said she felt great and the dogs seemed eager to go out (reported 2023-10-06; injury date not specified). During the week of 2023-10-16..2023-10-22, she had a separate accident while playing with her dogs at a park and injured an arm. By 2023-10-24, she said caring for the dogs with one arm was manageable and she was feeling better each day.

Audrey’s tattoos honoring her dogs: she described an existing arm tattoo as representing her bond with her dogs and nature (reported by 2023-04-16). On 2023-08-16, she said she had gotten another tattoo of all four dogs on her arm. By 2023-10-13, she had added more drawings to the tattoo of the four dogs and said she currently had enough tattoos, though she might get another if she gets another dog.

Andrew’s dogs: Toby, a German Shepherd puppy, introduced on 2023-07-11 (D12:1; breed confirmed 2023-08-04, D14:19); Buddy, a male puppy adopted from a shelter by 2023-10-19, who was adjusting to Toby and his new home (D24:2, D24:4, D24:5, D24:6); and Scout, adopted by Andrew and his girlfriend by 2023-11-22, with a bed, toys, and puppy pads prepared for him (D28:6, D28:7, D28:8, D28:10, D28:12).

Andrew’s search for a dog and dog-friendly housing: On 2023-04-02, Andrew had no dog of his own and was seeking a dog-friendly apartment, hoping to get a dog soon; Audrey recommended housing websites with pet filters (D2:8, D2:10). By 2023-05-06, he was browsing websites, visiting shelters, asking friends, and contacting landlords, while considering a smaller dog suitable for apartment life; he planned another shelter visit (D5:1, D5:3, D5:5, D5:21). On 2023-06-02, the housing search remained unsuccessful and he felt discouraged but determined (D7:7, D7:8). On 2023-07-03, finding dog-friendly housing was still difficult (D10:2, D10:4). By 2023-07-11, he had brought puppy Toby home, about 100 days after first discussing his search, although the records do not say whether he had found the desired dog-friendly housing (D12:1).
rollups.topic: Dog adoption and dog-friendly housing search

rollups.text: Andrew’s outdoor life and work-life balance: By 2023-04-08, Andrew missed hiking and described nature as restorative while city life left him feeling deprived of the outdoors (D3:1, D3:3, D3:5, D3:7, D3:9). On 2023-05-03, he had found nearby open space for hiking and usually tried to hike at least once each weekend (D4:2, D4:3, D4:4). He hiked with friends and his girlfriend on 2023-05-06..2023-05-07 (D6:1), and with friends on 2023-06-23 (D9:18, D9:20). By 2023-07-03, difficulty finding dog-friendly housing and time outdoors led him to explore urban activities and cook more (D10:2, D10:4, D10:12). On 2023-07-11, stressful work kept him indoors and he planned an August hike (D12:3, D12:5). On 2023-09-06, he said demanding work had sidelined outdoor activities; simple coffee and lunchtime walks helped him recharge, and he had hiked during the preceding weekend (D18:1, D18:5, D18:15). On 2023-10-04, he still felt a void from reduced access to nature because of city living and work-life balance (D21:5, D21:7).

Andrew’s outdoor activities and nature outings: hiking was his favorite outdoor activity by 2023-08-04 (D14:11); he hiked with friends and his girlfriend on 2023-05-06..2023-05-07 (D6:1), with friends on 2023-06-23 (D9:18), and went hiking during the weekend before 2023-09-06 (D18:15). Other reported outings included a picnic with his girlfriend on 2023-07-07 (D11:1), a farm visit with his girlfriend to get vegetables on 2023-08-16 (D15:2), fishing with her at a nearby lake on 2023-08-19..2023-08-20 (D17:1), and a bike ride with her to a park outside town on 2023-11-04 (D27:1). He also took a rock-climbing class with friends on 2023-06-11 and reached the top (D8:1, D8:3, D8:5).

Andrew’s food and restaurant experiences: on 2023-04-08, he and his girlfriend tried a city café and had croissants, muffins, and tarts (D3:1, D3:11, D3:15, D3:17); on 2023-07-03, he was experimenting with cooking and was eager to try Audrey’s roasted chicken recipe (D10:12, D10:16, D10:18, D10:24, D10:26); on 2023-10-21..2023-10-22, he and his girlfriend attended a wine tasting and enjoyed trying unfamiliar wines (D25:1); by 2023-10-24, he had tried sushi for the first time at a local restaurant and planned to try California or salmon rolls with sauces (D25:3, D25:5, D25:7, D25:9, D25:11).

rollups.text: Plans for Andrew and Audrey to hike together with their dogs: on 2023-07-08, they discussed a future August hike, with Audrey wanting a scenic, safe place where her dogs could run freely (D11:5, D11:6, D11:8, D11:10, D11:11, D11:12). On 2023-07-11, Andrew invited Audrey and her dogs to join an August hike, but no specific date or place was settled in the record (D12:4, D12:5, D12:6). By 2023-10-19, they were planning a November hike and Audrey offered to research a good trail (D24:13, D24:17, D24:18, D24:19, D24:20, D24:21, D24:22).
